targetUrl.title: Your website
targetUrl.description: The web app to audit, for example https://groww.in. Audit sites you own or are allowed to assess. Only public pages are loaded: no login, no form submission, no probing.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: Your industry, in plain words. Used to find peers and to compare like with like.

peerUrls.title: Peer websites (optional)
peerUrls.description: 3 to 5 peer websites to benchmark against. Leave empty and the agent finds 3 to 5 similar sites itself. Peers are scanned the same way (public pages only). The report shows only their counts and scores, never their individual findings.

anonymizePeers.title: Anonymize peers
anonymizePeers.description: Show peers as Peer A, B, C in the report instead of by their site name.

llmApiKey.title: LLM API key (optional)
llmApiKey.description: Your own OpenRouter API key. Leave empty to use the Apify OpenRouter proxy, billed to your Apify account, with no key needed.

maxPages.title: Pages to visit
maxPages.description: How many public pages of your site to load. Peers get 2 pages each.

useCachedScan.title: Use saved captures
useCachedScan.description: Reuse the captures saved by the last run for each site instead of loading them again. Fast and reliable for demos.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy for the browser. Residential IPs keep big sites from blocking the crawl. If your plan has no residential access, the run continues without a proxy.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: If enabled, the full tool results are written to the log.
